tools.name: list_assessment_questions
tools.title: List assessment questions
tools.description: List the walking-wellness assessment questions with their answer options and value codes. Call this before build_walking_plan to learn the valid answer values.

tools.name: build_walking_plan
tools.title: Build a personalized walking plan
tools.description: Generate StrideWell's personalized result from assessment answers: profile archetype, 4-week walking progression, habit stack, and a 24-week weight projection estimate. Use list_assessment_questions for valid answer codes. Estimates only, not medical advice.

currentActivity.description: How much the person currently moves in a typical week.

startingWalk.description: Minutes of walking per day that feel realistic to start with.

primaryBarrier.description: The main thing that has gotten in the way before.

ageRange.description: Age band. Defaults to 45-49 when omitted.

heightInches.description: Total height in inches, e.g. 65. Defaults to 64.

currentWeightLb.description: Current weight in pounds. Defaults to 175.

goalWeightLb.description: Goal weight in pounds. Defaults to 20 lb below current weight.

sleep.description: Typical sleep quality; influences the habit stack.

stress.description: Typical stress level; influences the habit stack.
